summary: Oncolytics Biotech filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 furnishing a press release dated October 12, 2026, updating its intellectual property portfolio rather than announcing any special situation. The company disclosed that a new method-of-use patent covering pelareorep as cancer immunotherapy has issued in several countries, with U.S. issuance expected near term; three patent application families remain pending, including a Track One conversion planned this quarter and a planned composition-of-matter patent for next-generation pelareorep. Existing manufacturing patents run through 2044, with use protection targeted into the late 2040s. No deal terms, advisors, board recommendations, or shareholder actions were disclosed. No risk-arb angle applies.
